title: fagonia californica subsp. laevis
intro: Fagonia californica subsp. laevis, commonly known as California orache, is a shrub-like plant native to the southwestern region of North America. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits, such as reducing fever and pain. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Fagonia californica subsp. laevis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
